property_summary: For any deposited amount, the total sGlp that c ever transfers out to the junior vault never exceeds the amount staked into it; the mutant keeps dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance nonzero, so a second executeBatchDeposit transfers the amount out a second time, exceeding it.
change_summary: Replace `dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance = 0;` with `dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance = glpToTransfer;` so the balance is kept at its pre-call value instead of being zeroed.
